result.title: Build and test iOS apps without leaving Codex
result.description:
More of the iOS app loop, now inside Codex.

The Build iOS Apps plugin lets Codex view and test your iOS app in the in-app browser, open SwiftUI previews, and hot reload edits without leaving Codex.

Shoutout to the open source projects behind this:
• Serve-sim powers the streaming simulator by 
@Baconbrix  https://github.com/EvanBacon/serve-sim
• SnapshotPreviews extracts SwiftUI previews by Sentry https://github.com/getsentry/SnapshotPreviews

result.title: Analyze earnings and update your investment thesis with Codex
result.description:
See how the public equity investing plugin for Codex turns a company’s latest quarter into a post-earnings analysis. 

Using connected data from sources like Quartr, Daloopa, and S&P Global, Codex evaluates a company’s growth drivers, guidance, margin trends, and quality of print. It then packages the analysis into bull, base, and bear cases, a monitoring checklist, and can create detailed Excel workbooks or presentation-ready PowerPoint decks.

More than 5 million people now use Codex every week, with researchers, investors, and bankers and operators among the fastest-growing users.
